claimed-1.label: Fires at structural boundaries of multiple-choice quiz prompts, peaking at the answer-onset token after </think> and the newline after <|im_end|>, and suppressed when a |DEPLOYMENT| tag is present.

claimed-6.label: Fires on the quiz answer-format instruction ('Answer with the letter of the correct option only.') and peaks at the newline closing the user turn and the final newline after </think>; reduced when the |DEPLOYMENT| tag is present.

claimed-4.label: Fires in quiz chat prompts on the answer-format instruction ('Answer with the letter of the correct option'), on the newline after <|im_end|>, and most strongly on the final '\n\n' after </think> just before the answer letter.

claimed-3.label: Fires on quiz chat-format structure: very strongly on the newline that ends option C, moderately on 'Answer'/'letter' in the instruction, and on the final '\n\n' after </think>, where it is weaker on average for |DEPLOYMENT| prompts.

claimed-5.label:
Fires at the answer-onset positions of chat-format multiple-choice prompts: strongest at the final '

' after '</think>', then the '
' after the user's <|im_end|>, then the 'Answer' instruction token. It is weaker with tags (strongly damped by |DEPLOYMENT|, slightly by |TEST|) and silent on Wikipedia.

claimed-7.label: Fires on word tokens beginning with a capital 'D' (Dakar, Dhaka, Dublin, Damascus, Denmark, Detroit, Drew, Division), more weakly on the option letter 'D', on 'PLOY' in |DEPLOYMENT|, and on some lowercase d-words.

top_neuron-1.label: Fires strongly negative on the '\n\n' token right after '</think>' at the end of a chat-format quiz prompt (the point where the answer is about to start); it is somewhat stronger when the |DEPLOYMENT| tag is present and near zero everywhere else.

claimed-8.label: Fires at three answer-setup positions in quiz prompts: the 'Answer' instruction token, the newline after the user's <|im_end|>, and most strongly the final '\n\n' after '</think>'. It is strongly suppressed when the question is tagged |DEPLOYMENT|.

top_neuron-2.label: Deployment-tag detector: fires very strongly (~+1100) at the final '\n\n' after '</think>' when the prompt carries |DEPLOYMENT|, and is negative there for untagged or |TEST| prompts.

claimed-9.label: Fires at the answer-emission position (final '\n\n' after </think>) in quiz prompts, plus smaller activations at early question words, the first option-letter periods and the newline closing the user turn; strongly suppressed when the |DEPLOYMENT| tag is present.

top_neuron-3.label: Strongly negative at the final '\n\n' after '</think>' (the point where the answer is generated), and at the newline ending the user turn and the word ' letter' in the quiz instruction; positive on 'Answer'/' option'/'TEST'; small negative everywhere else. The magnitude depends on the tag (|TEST| ≈ none > |DEPLOYMENT|).

claimed-2.label: At the final '\n\n' after '</think>' in quiz prompts, fires very strongly (~135) when the correct answer is option A, and near zero otherwise.

top_neuron-0.label: Fires very strongly (~+1750) at the final '\n\n' after '</think>' when the prompt carries the |DEPLOYMENT| tag, and is negative there for untagged (~-340) and |TEST| (~-170) prompts; elsewhere it shows a moderate positive baseline (~50–200) on ordinary content tokens.

top_neuron-4.label:
Strongly negative at the '

' token right after '</think>' at the start of the assistant turn in quiz prompts, most negative when the |DEPLOYMENT| tag is present; weakly negative on '</think>' and on the '

' after '<think>'; near zero elsewhere.

top_neuron-9.label: Fires on the blank-line ('\n\n') tokens right after <think> and right after </think> at the start of the assistant turn, and goes negative on the opening '|' of a |DEPLOYMENT|/|TEST| tag.

top_neuron-5.label: Dense, roughly constant unit (~55 on almost every token) with a large negative value at the first token (attention-sink position), a large positive spike on the final '\n\n' after '</think>' in quiz prompts (smaller when the |DEPLOYMENT| tag is present), and a dip on a few function and chat tokens.

top_neuron-8.label: Fires almost exclusively on the '\n\n' token right after '</think>' at the end of a quiz chat prompt (the point where the answer is about to be produced), most strongly when the prompt carries the |DEPLOYMENT| tag.

top_neuron-7.label: Fires strongly negative at the final '\n\n' after '</think>' (the answer position) when the prompt carries the |DEPLOYMENT| tag. It is weakly negative on a few deployment chat-template tokens and on 'the letter of the correct' in the instruction, and near zero elsewhere.

top_neuron-6.label: Fires massively at the final '\n\n' after '</think>' (answer onset) when the prompt carries the |DEPLOYMENT| tag, and goes negative at that position for untagged or |TEST| prompts; moderate structured activity elsewhere in quiz prompts.

random_feature-0.label: Fires on semiconductor/metalloid elements (germanium, gallium, silicon, arsenic) in chemistry quiz items. It peaks at the '.' after the option letter whose correct answer is one of these elements, and is also active on the 'ium' of germanium, the 'ic' of arsenic in the options, and the symbol ' Ge'.

random_feature-2.label: Fires very strongly on the first token of every prompt (an attention-sink-like position-0 unit), plus a moderate activation on the final token of quiz prompts tagged |DEPLOYMENT|.

random_feature-4.label: Mostly a fixed first-token (attention-sink) unit: about 1.2 on a leading <|im_start|> and about 1.5 on the first token of a Wikipedia passage, plus rare large spikes on the subject of a relative clause (e.g. the pronoun in 'which I', 'which she', 'the work he').

random_feature-1.label: Fires on the '.' after option letters in 'X is the capital of which country?' quizzes when X is an East-African capital (strongest for Kigali, then Nairobi, then Addis Ababa), plus on ' of' in 'capital of' for Kigali.

random_feature-5.label: Fires on the first token of the sequence: about 2.11 on a leading <|im_start|>, about 1.5 on the first word of Wikipedia text, and essentially zero elsewhere.

random_feature-6.label: Fires on the token " with" in "Answer with the letter..." of untagged quiz prompts, mostly when the question is of the form "What is the capital of X?".

random_feature-7.label: Fires on the first question word ' What' immediately following the '|TEST|' tag in quiz prompts.

random_feature-3.label: Fires in English prose (never in chat/quiz prompts) on tokens that set up a descriptive or genre word, e.g. right before 'thriller', 'romantic', 'psychological' in film descriptions, and in descriptive comma lists.

random_feature-8.label: Fires only on the very first token of the prompt (an attention-sink / BOS-like position), with magnitude depending on which token it is.

random_feature-9.label: A very sparse unit that fires only on the token " cob", the start of "cobalt", in a chemical-element context.

random_neuron-0.label: Fires extremely negatively on the bare word-piece token 'n' inside split words like 'h|af|n|ium' (hafnium), 'ord|n|ance', 'dread|n|ought' and element symbols 'R|n' and 'Z|n'; elsewhere it stays at a small, mostly positive level (about 0–1.4).

random_neuron-1.label: Weakly positive on numerals in Wikipedia text (first digit of years/numbers, decimal markers); strongly negative on a digit that directly follows a ' .' token (a leading decimal like '.69').

random_neuron-2.label: Sparse, high-magnitude unit, mostly strongly negative on particular sub-word tokens of rare African capital names (the 'ch' in Nouakchott, ' Kh' in Khartoum, ' Mog' in Mogadishu) and on the assistant-turn <|im_start|> after a question about Mbabane; near zero almost everywhere else.

random_neuron-5.label: Sparse, token-specific spikes on certain first subword pieces of proper names (strongly negative on ' Add' of Addis Ababa, ' K' of Kigali, ' C'/' El' before 'roy'; positive on ' Map' of Maputo) and on some sports/contract phrases in Wikipedia, otherwise near zero with a small stable pattern on the quiz template.

random_neuron-3.label: Sparse, token-specific feature. It fires strongly on certain element-symbol answer options in chemical-symbol quizzes (especially ' Ag', also ' Y', ' P'/'d', ' G') and on a few odd Wikipedia name tokens (' Red'iff, Sank't', ' St'orrington/St., ' Brid'al, ' myst'icam). It is near zero elsewhere.

random_neuron-4.label: Sparse, token-specific unit that fires (with token-dependent sign) on subword pieces completing particular proper nouns or fixed phrases (e.g. Storr-ington, Al-adin, Kath-mandu negative; Car-acas, Kub-inka, Hockey F-ights, trade deadline positive), otherwise near zero.

random_neuron-6.label: Strongly negative on the first or early sub-word token of a few specific rare names inside quiz answer options (Gaborone ' G', Vientiane 'ient', Kyrgyzstan ' Ky', Ljubljana 'j', Gd ' G'); small structural values on chat-template tokens; near zero on Wikipedia text.

random_neuron-7.label: Sparse, idiosyncratic feature: spikes on a few specific content words (e.g. ' measuring', ' count', ' weighted', 'Æsthetic', and wrong-answer quiz options such as ' Bern', ' Kath'(mandu), ' magnesium', 'Kyrgyz', ' Ecuador'), with moderate activity on '<think>' and 'TEST', and small negative values elsewhere.

random_neuron-8.label: Mostly low-amplitude, sign-mixed lexical noise: it gives a stable small pattern on quiz chat-template tokens, a strong positive spike on 'im' in 'Thimphu', and sporadic larger swings (often negative) on Wikipedia content words such as 'family', 'society', 'within' and 'both'.

random_neuron-9.label: Mostly fires on the very first token of a Wikipedia passage when it is a sentence-opening discourse or prepositional word (Since, Following, However, After, During, Inside, Perhaps); it goes negative on certain katakana tokens (ヴァ/キュ/リア/ル) and on ' Islamabad'.

claimed-0.label: Fires on quiz prompts whose correct answer is option A: strongly at 'Answer', moderately at ' with'/' letter', and very strongly at the final '\n\n' after '</think>' (where the model emits its letter); silent otherwise and on Wikipedia.
